citations.text: The presenting best-corrected visual acuity (BCVA) and intraocular pressure (IOP) were recorded. The Snellen visual acuity was converted into a logarithm of the minimum angle of resolution i.e. logMAR for statistical analysis.
At each follow-up visit BCVA, IOP and SD-OCT were recorded.
Mean BCVA at post-operative 1-month in Group A and Group B was logMAR 0.68 ± 0.25 (Snellen equivalent 20/96) and logMAR 0.54 ± 0.19 (Snellen equivalent 20/69) (p = 0.016) respectively.

4.1.reasoning: BCVA measured using standard Snellen to logMAR conversion, a validated method for visual acuity.
